plant_paddy_brownspot.title: Paddy Brown Spot
plant_paddy_brownspot.symptoms: Oval brown spots with gray/white centers on leaves. Causes grain discoloration.
plant_paddy_brownspot.organic_cure: Spray Neem Oil (3%) or garlic extract. Improve soil silica.
plant_paddy_brownspot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds and treat with hot water (52°C) for 10 mins.

plant_paddy_blast.title: Rice Blast
plant_paddy_blast.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with white centers and reddish borders.
plant_paddy_blast.chemical_cure: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP (0.6 g/L) or Isoprothiolane.
plant_paddy_blast.prevention: Avoid excessive Nitrogen fertilizer. Maintain field water level.

plant_wheat_rust.title: Wheat Rust
plant_wheat_rust.organic_cure: Remove infected plants. Dust with sulfur powder.

plant_millet_blast.title: Millet Blast (Ragi)
plant_millet_blast.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions on leaves and neck rot preventing grain filling.
plant_millet_blast.prevention: Use resistant varieties like GPU-28. Sowing in July helps avoid peak blast.

plant_millet_downy_mildew.title: Downy Mildew (Green Ear)
plant_millet_downy_mildew.symptoms: Leaves turn yellow/white (chlorosis). Earheads turn into leafy structures (Green Ear).
plant_millet_downy_mildew.organic_cure: Roguing (remove infected plants). Seed treatment with Trichoderma.
plant_millet_downy_mildew.prevention: Crop rotation with pulses. Deep ploughing in summer.

plant_millet_smut.title: Grain Smut
plant_millet_smut.symptoms: Grains are replaced by black powdery spore masses.
plant_millet_smut.prevention: Use clean, certified seeds. Remove smutted earheads carefully.

animal_cow_lumpy.title: Lumpy Skin Disease (Cattle)
animal_cow_lumpy.symptoms: Nodules on skin, fever, reduced milk yield.
animal_cow_lumpy.organic_cure: Apply turmeric and aloe vera paste on nodules.
animal_cow_lumpy.chemical_cure: Administer antibiotics for secondary infection (Consult Vet).
animal_cow_lumpy.prevention: Goat Pox Vaccine is effective. Isolate infected cattle.
